annotations.title: Book a call with a lead

description: Book a call on the coach's calendar provider and have the provider invite the lead's email; the lead also gets Luca's booking confirmation. Works for call types on Calendly, Cal.com, or Google Calendar. Reads the open slots of the call type first and books the one that starts at slotAt. When that slot is taken it books nothing and returns the open slots instead, so pick one of them and call again. The answer is usually pending while the provider confirms; check it with luca_bookings_provider_requests_get. The booking puts an event on the coach's calendar and invites the lead, so pass confirm: true only after the coach approves this exact slot. If a retry answers slot_not_available, the first attempt may have taken the slot, so check luca_bookings_list before booking again. To record a call that is already on a calendar, use luca_bookings_create instead. Example: call with { leadId, bookingTypeId, slotAt: "2026-07-14T15:00:00Z", inviteeEmail: "sam@example.com", confirm: true } after the lead agreed to a time.

bookingTypeId.description: The call type to book, from luca_bookings_types_list. Its provider is the calendar the call lands on.

confirm.description: This tool has a real-world side effect: it messages real leads, books, moves, or cancels a call, changes a lead's consent, imports leads, writes to a connected calendar or CRM, sends workspace events to an outside URL, or re-triggers downstream automations. Pass confirm: true to proceed; the call is rejected without it.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when retrying this exact booking, so a repeat of a request that already reached the API cannot book the call twice.

inviteeEmail.description: The lead's email. The provider sends the invite there.

inviteeName.description: The lead's name as the invite should show it.

slotAt.description: ISO-8601 start time for the call, with an offset. It must be an open slot of the call type, as luca_bookings_managed_availability lists them.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the booking is shown in, such as Europe/Madrid. Defaults to UTC.
